info.title: Air & Insights Copilot
info.description:
Agentic assistant that provides air quality and weather guidance.
    
    ## Features
    - **Air Quality**: PM2.5 and PM10 data from Open-Meteo
    - **Weather**: Temperature forecast from Open-Meteo  
    - **AI Guidance**: LLM-generated recommendations via GitHub Models
    - **NASA APOD**: Astronomy Picture of the Day (optional)
    
    ## Attribution
    Weather data by Open-Meteo.com

post.description:
Fetches air quality (PM2.5, PM10), temperature, and snow data for a location,
    then generates AI-powered guidance for outdoor activities.
    
    **Features:**
    - Accepts coordinates OR place name (auto-geocoded)
    - Data from Open-Meteo (free, no API key needed)
    - Snow data included (snowfall, snow depth)
    - AI guidance generated via GitHub Models LLM
    - Results cached for 10 minutes
    
    **Example with coordinates:**
    ```json
    {
        "latitude": 42.6977,
        "longitude": 23.3219,
        "hours": 6
    }
    ```
    
    **Example with place name:**
    ```json
    {
        "place_name": "Витоша",
        "hours": 6
    }
    ```

get.summary: Get NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day
get.description:
Fetches today's Astronomy Picture of the Day from NASA.
    
    This is a bonus feature that demonstrates calling external APIs.
    Uses NASA's free APOD API (DEMO_KEY or your own API key).

post.description:
Converts a place name (like "София" or "Vitosha") to geographic coordinates.
    
    Uses Google Maps Geocoding API.
    
    **Example request:**
    ```json
    {
        "place_name": "София"
    }
    ```
    
    **Example response:**
    ```json
    {
        "latitude": 42.6977,
        "longitude": 23.3219,
        "formatted_address": "Sofia, Bulgaria",
        "found": true
    }
    ```

post.summary: Get weather along a driving route
post.description:
Gets weather forecast at multiple waypoints along a driving route.
    
    Perfect for planning road trips! Shows:
    - Temperature at each waypoint
    - Air quality (PM2.5)
    - Snow conditions
    - Weather warnings
    
    **Example request:**
    ```json
    {
        "origin": "София",
        "destination": "Пловдив",
        "departure_hours_from_now": 0
    }
    ```
    
    **Response includes:**
    - Route distance and duration
    - Weather at 5 waypoints along the route
    - AI-generated summary
    - Warnings (ice, snow, air quality)

get.description:
Root endpoint - simple health check.

Returns a welcome message to confirm the API is running.
Useful for load balancers and monitoring systems.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to 90). Optional if place_name provided.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to 180). Optional if place_name provided.

place_name.title: Place Name
place_name.description: Place name to geocode (e.g., 'София', 'Vitosha'). Optional if coordinates provided.

AnalyzeRequest.title: AnalyzeRequest
AnalyzeRequest.description:
Request body for POST /analyze endpoint.

The client can provide EITHER:
- Coordinates (latitude, longitude)
- OR a place name (which will be geocoded automatically)

Example with coordinates:
    {
        "latitude": 42.6977,
        "longitude": 23.3219,
        "hours": 6
    }
    
Example with place name:
    {
        "place_name": "Витоша",
        "hours": 6
    }

pm25_avg.title: Pm25 Avg
pm25_avg.description: Average PM2.5 concentration (μg/m³) for the requested hours

pm10_avg.title: Pm10 Avg
pm10_avg.description: Average PM10 concentration (μg/m³) for the requested hours

temp_avg.title: Temp Avg
temp_avg.description: Average temperature (°C) at 2m height for the requested hours

snowfall_sum.title: Snowfall Sum
snowfall_sum.description: Total snowfall (cm) for the requested hours

snow_depth_avg.title: Snow Depth Avg
snow_depth_avg.description: Average snow depth (cm) on the ground

AnalyzeResponse.title: AnalyzeResponse
AnalyzeResponse.description:
Response body for POST /analyze endpoint.

Contains averaged air quality metrics, temperature, snow data, and AI-generated guidance.

Example:
    {
        "pm25_avg": 12.5,
        "pm10_avg": 18.3,
        "temp_avg": 15.2,
        "snowfall_sum": 2.5,
        "snow_depth_avg": 10.0,
        "guidance_text": "Air quality is moderate..."
    }

title.title: Title
title.description: Title of the Astronomy Picture of the Day

url.title: Url
url.description: URL to the image or video

ApodResponse.title: ApodResponse
ApodResponse.description:
Response body for GET /apod/today endpoint.

Returns NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day.
This is an optional/bonus feature.

Example:
    {
        "title": "The Andromeda Galaxy",
        "url": "https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/...",
        "explanation": "The Andromeda Galaxy is..."
    }

GeocodeRequest.title: GeocodeRequest

formatted_address.title: Formatted Address
formatted_address.description: Full formatted address returned by Google

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message if place was not found

GeocodeResponse.title: GeocodeResponse
GeocodeResponse.description:
Response body for POST /geocode endpoint.

Returns geographic coordinates for a place name.

Example (success):
    {
        "latitude": 42.6977,
        "longitude": 23.3219,
        "formatted_address": "Sofia, Bulgaria",
        "found": true
    }
    
Example (not found):
    {
        "latitude": null,
        "longitude": null,
        "formatted_address": null,
        "found": false,
        "error": "ZERO_RESULTS"
    }

departure_hours_from_now.title: Departure Hours From Now
departure_hours_from_now.description: When to depart (0 = now, 1 = in 1 hour, etc.)

RouteWeatherRequest.title: RouteWeatherRequest
RouteWeatherRequest.description:
Request body for POST /route-weather endpoint.

Gets weather forecast along a driving route from A to B.

Example:
    {
        "origin": "София",
        "destination": "Пловдив",
        "departure_hours_from_now": 0
    }

waypoints.title: Waypoints
waypoints.description: Weather data at each waypoint along the route

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: AI-generated summary of route weather conditions

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Weather warnings for the route (snow, ice, poor air quality, etc.)

RouteWeatherResponse.title: RouteWeatherResponse
RouteWeatherResponse.description:
Response body for POST /route-weather endpoint.

Contains weather forecast at multiple waypoints along the route.

Example:
    {
        "origin": "Sofia, Bulgaria",
        "destination": "Plovdiv, Bulgaria",
        "total_distance_km": 145.5,
        "total_duration_minutes": 98,
        "waypoints": [...],
        "summary": "Route: Sofia → Plovdiv. Temperature range: 2°C to 5°C...",
        "warnings": ["Below freezing temperatures expected"]
    }

location_name.title: Location Name
location_name.description: Name or description of this waypoint

eta_minutes.title: Eta Minutes
eta_minutes.description: Estimated time to reach this point (minutes from start)

WaypointWeather.title: WaypointWeather
WaypointWeather.description: Comprehensive road conditions for a single waypoint along the route.
